text: Added a short instruction to the assessment screen and replaced response text with intuitive directional symbols (▲▼◀▶●). Replaced the result page's retake button with a button that returns to the start screen so you can choose the assessment length again, and fixed an issue that could prevent the deployed site from running correctly.
You can now check the current version and release history right on the site.
Added new pages: About MYCORE12, The 12 Energies, Profile Guide, and a Journal of short reads.
Refined the English mobile response wording and button colors.
Added a button to discard an in-progress assessment and start over.
Added the ability to save your result as a Korean or English Markdown or text file.
Prepared the site to be discoverable through search engines.
MYCORE12 became fully available in both Korean and English.
Redesigned the assessment screen and added a choice of assessment length (18, 36, 54, or 72 questions).
Finalized all 64 profile names and redesigned the result page.
